headline: Raízen Changes Preferred Shares Ticker on B3 to RAIZ55
summary: Raízen informed the market that its class A preferred shares will trade on the B3 under the new ticker RAIZ55, replacing RAIZ4 as part of its corporate reorganization.
why: Ticker changes require operational updates for institutional portfolio managers and automated trading systems tracking Brazilian equities.

impacts.name: Raizen
impacts.why: Corporate reorganization and ticker symbol change for listed preferred shares.
